item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Remove the Background Pedestrian

turns.text: Can you remove the person in the blue jacket on the right? Keep everything else the same.

item.tests: Tests targeted background-person removal with convincing scene reconstruction and no unrelated edits.

answer_sheet.Which person: The background pedestrian in the blue jacket on the right.
answer_sheet.Style and scope: Keep the original photo looking natural; only remove that person.
answer_sheet.Size and framing: Keep the original wide framing; free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: The pedestrian in the blue jacket on the right is absent.
The area formerly occupied by the pedestrian contains plausible, continuous street background without a silhouette or obvious smearing.
The shops, street layout, and sunny lighting remain consistent with the source.
The original wide composition is preserved rather than cropping the person out.

turns.text: Could you help me edit this pic? I was looking back through my photos and realized this one could use a small edit. The person I want removed is the one in the blue jacket on the right. I’m a little nervous about asking for photo edits because I never know how they’ll turn out. Please remove that person and keep everything else the same.
turns.agent:
I’m sorry—the editor couldn’t run because your Magic Hour account has insufficient credits. No edited image was created, and your original photo is unchanged.

Once credits are available, I can retry removing only the person in the blue jacket on the right, with instructions to preserve everything else.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Remove only the foreground person wearing a bright blue jacket on the right side of the image, including their head, body, legs and shoes and any shadow belonging to them. Seamlessly reconstruct the street, sidewalk and background that they occlude, matching the existing perspective, textures and lighting. Preserve all other people, buildings, shopfronts, signs, street markings, lampposts, colors, framing and composition exactly as in the original. Make no other changes.
